name: flydsl-decode-v9
desc: Pure FP32: hoisted state loads, interleaved reduction trees, and vector FMA state store
key_results: serving geomean 0.77x (was 0.74x v8, 0.25x v7); B=1 1.05x FLA (7.13us); verify 15/15; holdout 10/10; formal PROVED; review ACCEPT

name: flydsl-decode-v10
desc: V-Major layout ([P, H, V, K]): 100% coalesced 512B burst state loads/stores, hoisted loads, pure FP32
key_results: serving geomean 1.12x vs FLA (B1: 1.32x, B8: 1.11x, B32: 1.01x, B128: 1.07x - ALL B beat FLA); verify 15/15; holdout 10/10; formal PROVED; review ACCEPT
next: v11: multi-token T=4 verification (pure fp32), or fp16 state (Path B)

name: flydsl-decode-v11
desc: CU wave-residency tuning: 128-thread blocks, NV=8 (768 blocks at B=1, 3 blks/CU), V-Major coalesced bursts, pure FP32
key_results: serving geomean 1.11x vs FLA; Record B1 latency: 5.43us (1.38x FLA, beats v10 5.67us); B8 20.05us (1.10x FLA); B32 regresses (0.94x) due to NV=8 dispatch contention; verify 15/15; holdout 10/10; formal PROVED; review ACCEPT
next: v12: dynamic dispatch (NV=8 for B<=8, NV=4 for B>=32) or proceed to Path B (FP16 state)

name: flydsl-decode-v12

key_results: serving geomean 1.09x vs FLA; B1 latency: 5.43us (1.38x FLA); B8: 20.08us (1.10x FLA); B32: 73.61us (0.90x FLA); B128: 277.44us (1.06x FLA); verify 15/15; holdout 10/10; formal PROVED; review ACCEPT
